title: The Smoulder on Thistlewind Bridge
story: Scorchwillow the Creeping Smoulder is a slow orange flame-spirit that eats rope bridges plank by plank, and it has started at the far end of the 90-foot Thistlewind Bridge. The smoulder creeps forward at 2.4 feet per minute. Mr 6 charges on from the near end with a sloshing barrel of fogwater, soaking 3.6 feet of planks per minute — and soaked planks simply refuse to burn.
question: If both keep moving at those steady rates until they meet, how many feet of bridge will Mr 6 have soaked and saved?
solution: Together they cover the bridge at 2.4 + 3.6 = 6 feet per minute, so they meet after 90 ÷ 6 = 15 minutes.
praise: Adding the two speeds to find the meeting time was exactly the right plan — one more step turned those minutes into feet of rescued bridge.
hint: They're closing the 90-foot gap together — add their speeds first to find how many minutes until they meet.
victory: The smoulder hisses into a sulky puff of steam on the wet planks and shrinks to the size of a birthday candle, which Mr 6 politely carries home to light the village lanterns.
imagePrompt: A numeral-six knight in a blue cape sprinting across a long rope bridge over a misty canyon, sloshing a barrel of silver fogwater onto the planks while a creeping orange flame-spirit inches toward him from the far end, dramatic dusk light and swirling smoke.
